turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed any changes in my eyesight—no blurriness, dark spots, or any loss of vision.”

turns.doctor_question: To help me get a better picture of your overall health, could you tell me if you currently smoke or have a history of smoking?
turns.patient_answer: “Hi doctor—no, I don’t smoke and I don’t have a history of smoking. I only drink alcohol occasionally.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of how you're feeling, have you been experiencing any nausea or feeling sick to your stomach lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t had any nausea or stomach upset—I’m feeling well overall and this scalp lesion is the only thing that’s been on my mind.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your health, have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breast area that do not cause you any pain?

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of your symptoms, have you noticed if your urine has been darker than usual lately?

turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any mass in my breast area at all, so there hasn’t been any growth or rapid change. My only concern remains the lesion on my scalp.”

turns.doctor_question: I understand. To help me get a better picture of what you're experiencing, could you tell me if you are currently having any pain in your wrist?
